newsitem.title: USA: CypherCom says having liquidity troubles.
newsitem.headline: CypherCom says having liquidity troubles.

text.p: CypherCom Solutions Inc said Monday it was experiencing liquidity difficulties and was considering all of its alternatives.

CypherCom said attempts to get financing have been thwarted by the terms of its outstanding series A convertible preferred stock, which permit conversion at a 20 percent discount to the market price of CypherCom common.
CypherCom said it believed some holders were repeatedly converting preferred shares into common stock, then selling the common on the open market.
This has depressed the company's share price enough to make additional financing and other strategic solutions very difficult, the company said.
Negotiations with the holders of the preferred shares have so far proved unsuccessful, it said.
"The company is considering all of its alternatives and will make a further announcement when appropriate," Chairman Dennis Charter said.
